_doc: Post-extraction triage configuration (Track Q, Part A). One-time, version-controlled, decoupled from the pipeline logic. Edit this file to change tiering — the pipeline reads it, never re-asks.

kg_goal.note: Themes (BeleidsThema/BeleidsPijler) are the primary navigation lens. Actors are deliberately LIMITED (initially) to ministries, regions, and programmes — incl. RegioDeal and named programmes like NOVEX as programme-level actors. Indicators/metrics and loose amounts are detail (reference), NOT core.

relation_predicates.note: Predicate tier sets an edge's BASE strength. Structural edges count toward connectivity from a single document. Weak edges (RELATED — often machine-inferred co-occurrence) count as WEAK from one document (backbone-check flags them), BUT the SAME weak edge recurring across >= weak_promotion_min_docs documents PROMOTES and counts toward connectivity — so entities that become increasingly connected by recurring cross-document RELATED links earn 'active'. SECURED BY: relation-merge (B2) must dedup edges (same src+tgt+predicate) and union relation.source_documents cumulatively; the per-edge cross-doc count then drives promotion. Without that merge, recurrence scatters across duplicate edges and cannot promote.

status_rules._note: tier x effective-degree -> status. Effective degree = count of STRUCTURAL edges + count of PROMOTED weak edges (a weak/RELATED edge whose cross-doc count >= weak_promotion_min_docs). A single-doc RELATED edge does NOT count and is backbone-flagged; a multi-doc RELATED edge DOES count. Status is re-derived EVERY run, so as documents accumulate, recurring cross-doc links promote reference->active idempotently — that is the promotion guarantee.
rules: active-tier type AND degree == 0            -> active, BUT review-queue: 'isolated core actor / possible extraction gap'
reference-tier type AND degree >= 3         -> reference, BUT review-queue: 'candidate active'
unsure_review-tier type                      -> reference by default, ALWAYS review-queue: 'unsure — operator decides'
manual_override == true                      -> keep operator status, automation NEVER overwrites
